description: This file contains implementation of ASN.1 message structures and methods for encoding, decoding, and JSON serialization related to BCCH-BCH messages in 3GPP NR RRC protocol, including classes for message types, configuration, and MIB.

classes.name: bcch_bch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the BCCH-BCH message sequence containing a message object.

classes.name: bcch_bch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice of message type, either MIB or message class extension.

classes.name: mib_s
classes.description: Represents the MIB message structure with various configuration parameters.

classes.name: pdcch_cfg_sib1_s
classes.description: Represents the PDCCH-ConfigSIB1 ASN.1 sequence with control resource set and search space identifiers.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the object from bit stream.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the object into JSON format.

methods.name: set_mib
methods.description: Sets the message type to MIB.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to message class extension.
